global_identity.color_palette: Lemon yellow #F5E13A (ribbon, highlighted word, the 'Pagas al recibir' badge), amber brown #9A4F12 (glass and warm accents), deep cocoa #2B1A10 (top pill, darkened bottom vignette, text on yellow), warm cream #FFF6DC (linen and serif headline), white #FFFFFF (text on red and on cocoa), gold #C9962B (engraved seal, thin card border, ornaments), offer red #D62828 used ONLY for the offer pill 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses'.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bold direct-response health ad built around the real amber dropper bottle with its yellow label; the same bottle, the same palette, the same red offer pill and the same bordered yellow 'Pagas al recibir' badge in every image.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm, trustworthy and warm: side window light on cream linen, a gold engraved seal like a promise, a real young Colombian woman who goes from loose jeans to jeans that fit.
global_identity.graphic_language: Cream linen with real folds, one large gold engraved circular seal ring with small leaf ornaments, a lemon-yellow satin ribbon, a framed cocoa pill with notched corners at the top, one rounded photo card with a thin gold border and a small result inset, one red offer pill and one bordered yellow badge; no logos.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display Bold, uppercase) in warm cream #FFF6DC with the word 'PRIMERO' in lemon yellow #F5E13A; value proposition in Playfair Display Italic warm cream; top pill and seal ring in Poppins SemiBold uppercase; offer and badge in Poppins ExtraBold.

creative_objective: Remove the fear of the woman who already got burned buying online: nothing is paid before the bottle is in her hands. The guarantee seal of the reference becomes a gold seal of 'sin suscripción, sin pagar nada antes', the headline says receive first and pay later, a photo card shows her loose-jeans moment and her result, and the fixed offer with 'Pagas al recibir' closes it.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The big two-line serif headline at the bottom with 'PRIMERO' in yellow; 2) the bottle wrapped in the yellow ribbon in front of the gold seal; 3) the photo card with the loose-jeans moment and the result inset; 4) the top pill and the italic value proposition; 5) the bottom offer and trust block.
art_direction.composition_style: Same order as reference mv-55: a small framed pill at the top center, a large engraved circular seal behind the bottle filling the middle, the bottle in the center with a satin ribbon wrapped around its body and trailing diagonally across the linen, the two-line serif headline and italic subtitle at the bottom. To fit the mandatory pain scene, the seal and bottle sit slightly right of center and a tall rounded photo card occupies the left side of the middle zone; the small survey line of the reference becomes the offer and trust block.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top pill 3-11 % of height, centered; seal ring centered at about 62 % of width, spanning about 10-78 % of height; photo card left 3-46 % of width, 14-72 % of height; bottle 54-74 % of width, 18-68 % of height; headline 72-85 %; value proposition 85-91 %; bottom block 91-99 %. Margins about 3-4 %.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft side window light from the upper left, slightly warm (about 4500 K), long soft shadows in the linen folds, the bottle with a soft contact shadow and a faint amber glow through the glass; the bottom 30 % darkens gently toward deep cocoa so the cream serif headline reads with high contrast.

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference: overhead still life on cream linen with diagonal folds and soft side light. Top center: a small dark-green rectangular pill with notched corners and a thin frame, cream uppercase guarantee text. Behind everything, a large engraved gold circular seal with curved text around the ring and small leaf ornaments at left and right. Center: one amber dropper bottle standing upright, about 45 % of the canvas height, wrapped by a green satin ribbon that trails diagonally from lower left to upper right. Bottom 30 %: darker vignette, a huge two-line serif headline in cream, a two-line italic serif subtitle, and a tiny sans-serif survey line at the very bottom. No person, no button, no price. Adaptation: cocoa pill, gold seal with our text, lemon-yellow ribbon, our bottle, our headline and value proposition; a photo card with the pain scene and result inset is added on the left (mandatory in this app); the survey line becomes the offer pill and the 'Pagas al recibir' badge.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium still-life ad shot slightly from above (about 20 degrees, 50 mm lens look) on warm cream #FFF6DC linen with large soft diagonal folds and a clearly visible natural weave, soft warm window light from the upper left casting long soft shadows in the folds. The bottom 30 % of the canvas darkens gently toward deep cocoa #2B1A10 so the text there reads clearly. TOP ZONE (3-11 % of height): centered, a deep cocoa #2B1A10 rectangular pill with notched corners and a thin 2 px gold #C9962B inner frame, about 46 % of the canvas width, with the text 'RECIBES · REVISAS · PAGAS' in Poppins SemiBold uppercase white #FFFFFF. BACKGROUND SEAL: a large engraved circular seal in gold #C9962B, like a debossed print on the linen, double thin ring, centered at about 62 % of the width, spanning about 10-78 % of the height; along its top arc the curved serif text 'SIN SUSCRIPCIÓN · SIN PAGAR NADA ANTES' written only once, and a small leaf ornament on the left and on the right of the ring; the rest of the ring is plain. MIDDLE ZONE (14-72 % of height): LEFT, a tall rounded photo card (3-46 % of width, corner radius 18 px, 2 px gold #C9962B border, soft drop shadow on the linen), a realistic smartphone photo of a real young Colombian woman, about 27, warm tan skin with visible pores and a small mole on her cheek, long straight black hair in a low ponytail with loose strands, no studio makeup, plain white ribbed tank top and light-blue jeans one size too big, standing sideways to the camera in front of a full-length bedroom mirror with a wooden frame, camera at hip height from the side, framed from the shoulders to the knees, her face turned to the mirror with a tired, disappointed half-frown; with one hand she pulls the back of the jeans waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap between denim and skin is clearly visible, a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pockets, one straight flat line from waist to thigh, thin straight thighs with loose fabric around them: flat, no curve, no volume. In the lower right corner of the card, a small inset (about 38 % of the card width, 3 px cream border, rounded 10 px): the same woman (same face, hair, skin) on another day outdoors on a sunny street, three-quarter facing the camera, smiling, mustard-yellow blouse and dark-indigo jeans that fit snugly on hips and thighs with no loose fabric, a curvier hourglass silhouette with hips clearly wider than her waist and thighs that fill the jeans, framed from the head to mid-thigh, never from behind. RIGHT, in front of the seal (54-74 % of width, 18-68 % of height): ONE amber-brown glass Boston-round dropper bottle exactly as in the attached product photo, standing upright, about 46 % of the canvas height, about 2.6 times taller than wide, ribbed matte black collar, tall matte black rubber dropper bulb with a rounded tip, dark amber liquid visible above the label, the lemon-yellow-to-white label facing the camera and legible with 'amua', 'VITALDROPS' in big bold white with a thin yellow outline, 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small outlined ingredient circles and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'. A lemon-yellow #F5E13A satin ribbon with a soft sheen wraps once around the lower part of the bottle below the word VITALDROPS, never covering it, and trails diagonally across the linen from the lower left of the bottle up to the right edge. Soft contact shadow under the bottle, faint warm glow through the glass, matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. BOTTOM ZONE: headline (72-85 % of height), centered, two lines in Playfair Display Bold uppercase, warm cream #FFF6DC, each line about 7 % of the canvas height: line 1 'RECÍBELO PRIMERO.' with only the word 'PRIMERO' in lemon yellow #F5E13A, line 2 'PAGAS DESPUÉS.'. Value proposition (85-91 % of height), centered, Playfair Display Italic, warm cream #FFF6DC, about 3 % of the canvas height, up to two lines: 'Tu jean ajustado en caderas y piernas en 3 meses, sin botar más plata en gomitas.' Offer and trust block (91-99 % of height), centered side by side: a red #D62828 rounded pill with white Poppins ExtraBold text 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses' and a lemon-yellow #F5E13A rounded badge with a 3 px white border and a small hand-and-box line icon, 'Pagas al recibir' in deep cocoa #2B1A10 Poppins ExtraBold. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it.
